name: puzzlepkm
description: Search, traverse, and extend your local PuzzlePKM knowledge base.
long_description: Gives Claude read access to the PuzzlePKM knowledge base on this machine: full-text search down to the individual note block and into the PDFs, Word documents, PowerPoint decks, Pages documents, Markdown and text files stored in project and reference-material folders, the link graph between notes, projects, reference materials, habits and tags, the scripture references PuzzlePKM extracts from note bodies, habit consistency, and a health report covering unlinked notes and Inbox backlog. Optional write tools can create topic notes, append to the day's daily note, set and log habits, and run a folder sync. Reads and writes go through the same repositories as the CLI and desktop app, so backlinks, scripture extraction, and sync paths stay correct. Everything runs against the local SQLite database; nothing leaves your machine. Writes are disabled unless you turn them on below.

repo_path.title: PuzzlePKM folder or app
repo_path.description: Either your PuzzlePKM checkout (the folder containing cli.mjs) or an installed PuzzlePKM.app — the app bundles the same CLI code, and the launcher resolves it inside Contents/Resources. An installed app must be built from a version that includes the MCP server.

node_path.title: Node executable
node_path.description: Absolute path to Node 22 or newer, which PuzzlePKM requires for its built-in node:sqlite support. An absolute path is required because apps launched from the Dock do not inherit your shell PATH, so a bare 'node' will not resolve when Node is installed via nvm.

allow_writes.title: Allow writing to the knowledge base
allow_writes.description: Leave off to keep Claude read-only. When on, Claude can create topic notes, append to daily notes, set and log habits, and run a folder sync. Reading is always available.

database_path.title: Database file (optional)
database_path.description: Only needed if you run PuzzlePKM against a non-default database. Leave blank to use the standard location for this platform.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Substring search across notes, blocks, projects, materials, habits, scriptures, tags, and document text

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Full-text search inside PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Pages, Markdown and text files in project and reference-material folders

tools.name: get_document_text
tools.description: Read one indexed document's extracted text

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Indexed documents with extraction status and index totals

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List objects of one kind, with paging

tools.name: get_object
tools.description: Fetch one object in full by kind and id

tools.name: get_note_context
tools.description: A note plus its blocks, tags, links, backlinks, and cited scriptures

tools.name: get_daily_note
tools.description: Read a day's daily note, defaulting to today

tools.name: get_backlinks
tools.description: What links to and from an object

tools.name: get_graph_neighborhood
tools.description: Walk the link graph outward from an object

tools.name: list_scripture_references
tools.description: Extracted scripture references and the notes citing them

tools.name: get_habit_log
tools.description: Per-habit consistency: cadence, gap since the last occurrence, and due state

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Tags with usage counts by object kind

tools.name: find_stale_notes
tools.description: Topic notes not touched in a while, for resurfacing

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Counts, sync root, and what needs attention

tools.name: create_topic_note
tools.description: Create a topic note from markdown (requires writes)

tools.name: update_topic_note
tools.description: Update a topic note's title, body, or tags (requires writes)

tools.name: append_to_daily_note
tools.description: Append markdown to a day's daily note (requires writes)

tools.name: set_habit
tools.description: Create a habit, rename it, set its target interval, or retire it (requires writes)

tools.name: log_habit
tools.description: Record that a habit was practised on a date, or remove an occurrence (requires writes)

tools.name: sync_now
tools.description: Reconcile the database with the sync folder (requires writes)
